name: sandglass-simple-timer
title: Sandglass - Simple Timer
description: Start a calm countdown timer with a live dial, pause or resume it, and get a Windows notification when time is up.
author: peter_teitscheid

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.description: Pick a preset or type a duration and watch a calm dial count down.

commands.name: toggle-timer
commands.title: Pause or Resume Timer
commands.description: Pause the running timer, or resume it if it is paused.

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.description: Stop the current timer without opening Raycast.

preferences.name: alertSound
preferences.title: Alert Sound
preferences.description: What plays when the timer finishes.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
